full_judgment: 5. To prove his possession, first defendant adduced some witnesses including his alleged bargadar D.W.3, D.W.4 who is the son of the plaintiffs daughter deposed that the first defendant had gifted some land out of the suit lands to him and he had built his house there on. First defendant exhibited Khatian of the suit lands recorded in his name. He also exhibited municipal tax receipts and rent receipts showing payment of taxes and rents by him for the suit lands.
